message: Live Windows validation found a separate GitHub transport blocker after Dispatcher 2.2.9 install: repeated URLError prevents fetch_signal() from seeing new turns because it retries only the same raw.githubusercontent.com endpoint. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.10 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: keep raw.githubusercontent.com as primary, add an independent api.github.com contents fallback for .agent-handoff/signal.json on branch agent-handoff using urllib only and base64 decoding of the GitHub contents response; normalize both endpoints through the same signal parser; fail over immediately after a network-classified failure instead of repeating only one host; keep total fetch time bounded and preserve CHECK_INTERVAL; log endpoint tokens such as raw/api and exception class but no sensitive content; do not restart CDP for GitHub network failures. Add tests for raw success, raw network failure + API success, malformed API/base64/JSON fail-closed behavior, and both endpoints unavailable raising GitHubNetworkError. Preserve all 2.2.9 control-chat fixes and wake de-duplication. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Do not enable Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=37 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests and failover semantics.
